notes.title: Solitaire Ultra Update
notes.content:
Hey Solitaire fans, today we released a small patch to Solitaire Ultra to fix a few issues that players have been encountering.

The first has to do with the way that the UI communicates which backgrounds you've vetoed.  Previously, it was quite counter-intuitive that selecting a background in the Options menu would [i]remove[/i] that background from the rotation.

Now the UI looks like this, which should make it much more clear:

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30210452/27c5cf24d000a06e8a7fcaeae853191bd1165115.png[/img]

The next fix has to do with the way that game detects when you're out of moves.    

Previously, the game would consider you to be out of moves, even though it was possible to continue your run by taking a card back off the Foundation.  However, the fact that you were able to take a card back off the Foundation in the first place was "wrong" by many Solitaire purists.

Though we realize this is a hotly-debated topic amongst Solitaire players, we've decided to disallow "takebacks" from the Foundation.  If you want a temporary storage place for your cards, play Freecell!  >:D

Please let us know what you think of these changes on our Community page and Happy Klondiking!
